title: hbench dataset config, v1
description: The config blob (media type application/vnd.hbench.dataset.config.v1+json) of an hbench dataset: an OCI image manifest with artifactType application/vnd.hbench.dataset.v1 and one application/vnd.oci.image.layer.v1.tar+gzip layer per task. `tasks` lists the manifest's layers in the same order.

name.description: Dataset name, as in `-d <name>@<version>`. It is the last component of the dataset's OCI repository, so it follows the OCI repository-name rules.

version.description: Dataset version: semver without build metadata, the patch number optional (2.0, 2.0.1, 3.0.0-rc.1). It is the manifest's tag.

license.description: SPDX licence expression covering the dataset's tasks, e.g. Apache-2.0 or MIT AND CC-BY-4.0.

revision.description: The upstream commit, tag or release the tasks were packed from.

citation.description: How to cite the upstream dataset, e.g. BibTeX.

canary.description: The canary string the dataset's files carry, so training corpora can filter them out.

name.description: Task directory name; equals the layer's org.opencontainers.image.title annotation.

layer_digest.description: Digest of the task's layer, as in the manifest.

package_digest.description: The task's package digest (lock.json's task.digest, `hbench tasks digest`); equals the layer's dev.hbench.task.package-digest annotation.

docker_image.description: The prebuilt image the task runs in, pinned by digest.

platforms.description: Platforms the task's environment runs on, as os/arch[/variant].

timeouts.description: The task's timeouts in seconds, as its task.toml sets them.
